title: adversarial-research: P0 research subskill 8/9 + control 25 (REFUTED blocks RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT, earned)
objective: Build the adversarial-research subskill: a concise SKILL.md for the independent challenge team that tries to refute the recommendation (omitted/non-independent evidence, counterexamples, unsupported assumptions, uninspected surface, confirmation bias), separate from the originating run, casting sealed CONFIRMED/REFUTED/INCONCLUSIVE ballots through the framework council. Add control 25 (earned): a challenge council carrying a REFUTED ballot cannot reconcile to RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED (8 of 9 P0).
business_value: An independent challenge that can be overridden by declaring sufficiency is theatre; making a REFUTED ballot foreclose RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT means a critical contradiction cannot be erased by a majority or by the disposition, which is the point of a separate challenge team.
in_scope: skill-registry entry adversarial-research IMPLEMENTED with a real digest
control 25 in validate_research_record (earned): REFUTED ballot => not RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT
acceptance.md control 25 row; root SKILL.md router (8 of 9)
tests failing-first + mutation; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: checking whether a ballot actually attempted refutation (reviewer honesty; declared via non_coverage, not machine-checkable)
any move of badf-research off DESIGNED
acceptance_criteria: adversarial-research/SKILL.md exists, is concise, registry digest == sha256(source), status IMPLEMENTED
a challenge with a REFUTED ballot and disposition RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT is refused
a REFUTED ballot with a non-sufficient disposition (e.g. CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE) passes; the CONFIRMED challenged example still passes
root SKILL.md routes adversarial-research (8 of 9); acceptance.md documents control 25 (24 of 25)
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Eighth P0 research subskill. Control 25 earned by a failing-first probe (REFUTED + RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT passed). Reconciles WP-2026-0052. badf-research stays DESIGNED (8 of 9 P0); research controls to 24 of 25. Only research-reconciliation (9/9) + control 15 remain to complete the P0 family.
